**Frame:** Deletion events keep appearing, but so do new pages: for every removed page, more arrive. A short lettered pair of counts, the second visibly larger than the first.

**Caption:**
> REMOVAL WAS NOT DETECTION. IT WAS MAINTENANCE, AND IT WAS LOSING.

**Provenance:** `documented` + `inferred` — the corpus records 1,246 deletion-only pages with no stored revision alongside the stored ones (`dse_admin_deleted_pages_without_held_page`); the rate comparison is the project's reading of the event stream, not a measured throughput.

", "title": "New pages outpace the removals" } }
